tagline: Make it easier for everyone to experience the world
hero_kpi_rationale: The volume of room nights booked is the primary indicator of real demand in online travel and directly reflects the core business dynamics of Booking.com, the group's main engine. Historic record reached in 2025.

kpis.name: Room Nights Booked
kpis.explanation: Total number of room nights booked through the group's platforms.
kpis.description: The company reached a record volume of room nights in 2025, driven by demand in Europe and Asia.
kpis.signal: Historic record in 2025, signaling a strong recovery in travel.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from booking services and other activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $26.9 billion in 2025, driven by higher bookings and service expansion. Source confirmed in the 10-K.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting the cost of services sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin remains high due to the commission-based model and absence of significant inventory costs.
kpis.signal: High margin typical of a digital platform with no heavy assets.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved due to cost reductions and automation.
kpis.signal: Improvement driven by efficiency gains from the Transformation Program.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are increasing to strengthen technological capabilities and user experience.
kpis.signal: Capex focused on technology and generative AI.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount increased slightly, focused on product, data, and AI teams.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, targeted at tech and AI.

kpis.name: Generative AI Integration
kpis.explanation: Launch of generative AI features to enhance user and operational experience.
kpis.description: In 2025, Booking.com and Agoda integrated AI assistants for travel planning. Source confirmed: 'integrating new generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) features to enhance the consumer and partner experience'.
kpis.signal: Generative AI deployed across all major brands.

kpis.name: Connected Trip Vision
kpis.explanation: Progress in simplifying the travel journey (planning, booking, experience).
kpis.description: The Connected Trip rollout accelerated in 2025 with integrated features on Booking.com. Source confirmed: 'continued advancement towards our Connected Trip vision to make planning, booking, and traveling simpler, more personalized, and seamless'.
kpis.signal: 70% of users impacted by at least one aspect of the Connected Trip.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Increased competition from AI and major technology platforms
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in industry risks and the language intensity is high. The emergence of generative AI is presented as a major factor of potential disruption to the current business model.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party suppliers and distribution platforms
risks.score_rationale: This risk is emphasized by reliance on travel service providers and platforms such as Google. The language is strong and algorithm changes on these platforms reinforce the severity.

risks.title: Economic volatility and geopolitical uncertainties affecting tourism
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified as a major factor. Impact on discretionary spending and currency and price volatility are indicators of high severity.

risks.title: Adapting to rapid technological changes and innovation
risks.score_rationale: The text stresses the speed of technological change. Failure to keep pace with innovation is presented as a major risk to competitiveness.

risks.title: Risks related to growth and international expansion
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with factors such as changing economic conditions and foreign regulatory requirements. Although less intense than AI-related risks, it remains significant for a global company.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks in alternative accommodations
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically tied to alternative accommodations, with mentions of evolving regulatory complexity. The regulatory environment remains in constant flux.

risks.title: Safety and liability risks in alternative accommodations
risks.score_rationale: This risk concerns user safety and the platform's potential liability for user-generated content and behavior in alternative accommodations.

ai_positioning.summary: Booking Holdings is actively integrating generative artificial intelligence into its platforms and operations in 2025, particularly to enhance user experience and operational efficiencies. The company is partnering with leading generative AI players and views AI as a key component of its strategic initiatives.
evidence: Integration of new generative AI features to enhance consumer and partner experience
Partnership with leading generative AI organizations
Deployment of AI assistants on Booking.com and Agoda for travel planning
Generative AI used to accelerate the Connected Trip initiative
